metas.name: 1 · ★ 4.8 · 1974 · Beyond the Door
metas.description: Juliet Mills plays a young pregnant woman in San Francisco who is going to have the devil's baby during her strange possession. Richard Johnson shows up to help her... but what does he really want?

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.2 · 1977 · Shock
metas.description: A couple is terrorized in their new house haunted by the vengeful ghost of the woman's former husband, who possesses their young son.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.2 · 1989 · Beyond the Door III
metas.description: An introverted American student of Balkan descent travels to Yugoslavia as part of a school trip to witness an ancient pagan ritual, but the pagans hide a deadly secret.
